reference.review_authority: User confirmed this file is reviewed in chat.

graph.semantic_bilingual_matching: User-reviewed graph; no separate blind bilingual ratings supplied.

original_graph_comparison.interpretation: Precision/F1 assume absent links are negative. This is conditional agreement, not independently validated prerequisite precision. Direct-link graphs may differ in transitive redundancy.

v2_prerequisite_retrieval.interpretation: Macro recall of reviewed direct positive links in the deployed selector. Same graph defines candidate eligibility: tests ranking/bank coverage, not independent educational importance.

diagnosis.scope: 60 synthetic development scenarios x two languages x three methods. Not learner accuracy. Language answers use equivalent keys: identical diagnosis metrics are expected.
diagnosis.policy: Max three asked items per method; no unseen responses or labels provided to selectors. No prior learner evidence. All arms access the whole bank. Fixed/adaptive prioritise target then same chapter without edges; graph prioritises direct prerequisites.
diagnosis.limitations: Synthetic response packs are graph-derived and baselines are simple target-first heuristics, not optimised models. Exact gap-set agreement counts an empty predicted set as correct for non-gap cases even when evidence is insufficient; interpret together with unresolved rate. This is not an unbiased causal estimate of graph benefit.

retrieval.scope: AI-authored development cases; independent human review pending. Cases were written after development inspections, not an unseen holdout.
retrieval.recall_denominator: Relevant chunks in the concept-scoped candidate pool, not all textbook passages. Zero-denominator cases reported separately, never counted as perfect recall.
retrieval.span_metric: Lexical reference-term occurrence coverage in page-matching chunks; independent human support-span coverage pending.

bilingual.reason: Numbers, units, presence of Hindi and canonical labels are automated checks; meaning and terminology suitability still need blind bilingual review.

explanation.interpretation: Offline authored fallback only. Arithmetic/angle assertion checks and citation IDs do not establish mathematical correctness, relevance or citation entailment.
explanation.controlled_comparison: Three offline generator arms saved with equal context ceilings; live model comparison unavailable and blind ratings pending.

feedback.interpretation: Branch execution and rotated-question scoring tested; useful pedagogical next-action ratings require independent review.

workflow.scope: In-process actual retrieval and offline answer path, first pass with shared caches. Includes local computation; excludes network model latency. Browser/quiz end-to-end coverage recorded separately.

complete_chat_cycles.scope: Five synthetic profiles in both languages through actual persisted chat send/check/inline-grade/feedback paths; offline generation.

workflow.timing_limitations: First-pass ten-chapter measurements shared CPU with other evaluation processes; complete-chat cycles reuse popular angle caches. Not an isolated production latency benchmark; no external-model latency included.

document_coverage.scope_resolution: Document original three chapters used for diagnosis comparison; user later explicitly expanded deployed application to ten chapters.
